subject: Food Science
title: Precision Fermentation
description: A quick win: understand Precision Fermentation.

hook.text: 90% of cheese rennet today is made by genetically engineered microbes, not calf stomachs.

buildup.text: Precision fermentation programs microorganisms (yeast, bacteria, fungi) to produce specific proteins, fats, or flavors identical.

discovery.text: Whey protein, collagen, egg white protein, and casein can all be made by precision fermentation.

twist.text: Heme—the molecule that makes meat taste 'meaty'—is produced by Impossible Foods using precision fermentation in yeast.

climax.text: Insulin has been made by precision fermentation since 1982—the first commercial application.

punchline.text: Program a microbe. Feed it sugar. Harvest identical protein.

quiz.question: What is precision fermentation?
options: Programming microorganisms to produce specific proteins identical to animal-derived versions
A new type of beer brewing
